issue.title: Unwrap TwoPhaseIterator in MinScoreScorer

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
A ConjunctionScorer can add the approximation of the TwoPhaseIterator of a MinScoreScorer to its TwoPhaseIterator list after the main TwoPhaseIterator. This can lead to an undesired state, as the `matches()` method is called after the `score()` method. For example, if the `matches()` method of ToParentBlockJoinQuery is called after the `score()` method, then we return a wrong result or over-read DocValues. Here, we wrap the approximation to prevent it from unwrapping as a TwoPhaseIterator.

~Another option is to adjust the ToParentBlockJoinQuery to allow `matches()` to be called after `score()` (please see https://github.com/dnhatn/lucene/commit/a5222adb0d29d1a7d952d88171c25d151de9e0fc).~

Closes #79658
